passages.text: Our geography group prepares a fact file about the trees in the school garden. Each page records an observed detail, such as where a tree stands and what its leaves look like. We take the pages outside to check that our descriptions match the actual trees. A sudden wind begins to blow away the loose pages, so we quickly hold them down. We put the pages on a firm board with a clip before continuing our checks. Back in class, we correct two descriptions and keep the final file together in a folder.

parallelText.en: Our geography group prepares a fact file about the trees in the school garden.
parallelText.zh: 我们地理小组准备一份关于学校花园树木的事实档案。

parallelText.en: Each page records an observed detail, such as where a tree stands and what its leaves look like.
parallelText.zh: 每页记录一个观察到的细节，比如树的位置和叶子外形。

parallelText.en: We take the pages outside to check that our descriptions match the actual trees.
parallelText.zh: 我们带着记录页到户外，检查描述是否与真实树木一致。

parallelText.en: A sudden wind begins to blow away the loose pages, so we quickly hold them down.
parallelText.zh: 一阵突如其来的风开始吹走松散的纸页，我们赶快按住它们。

parallelText.en: We put the pages on a firm board with a clip before continuing our checks.
parallelText.zh: 我们把纸页夹在坚固的板子上，然后继续核对。

parallelText.en: Back in class, we correct two descriptions and keep the final file together in a folder.
parallelText.zh: 回到教室后，我们修改了两处描述，把最终档案一同放进文件夹。

wordHelp.meaning: a small object that holds things together

passages.text: Our science club makes a wall display about the solar system. We draw the Sun and the planets on separate cards so that we can arrange the model carefully. One member wants to fill the background with hundreds of tiny paper stars. Before we begin, the teacher asks whether a crowded background will make the main labels harder to read. We try a small section first, then choose fewer stars and larger labels. The finished display is easier to follow because the main information does not get lost among the decorations.

parallelText.en: Our science club makes a wall display about the solar system.
parallelText.zh: 我们科学社团制作一个关于太阳系的墙面展示。

parallelText.en: We draw the Sun and the planets on separate cards so that we can arrange the model carefully.
parallelText.zh: 我们把太阳和行星画在不同卡片上，以便仔细布置模型。

parallelText.en: One member wants to fill the background with hundreds of tiny paper stars.
parallelText.zh: 一位成员想用数以百计的小纸星星铺满背景。

parallelText.en: Before we begin, the teacher asks whether a crowded background will make the main labels harder to read.
parallelText.zh: 开始前，老师问，拥挤的背景是否会让主要标签更难阅读。

parallelText.en: We try a small section first, then choose fewer stars and larger labels.
parallelText.zh: 我们先试做一小块，然后决定用较少的星星和较大的标签。

parallelText.en: The finished display is easier to follow because the main information does not get lost among the decorations.
parallelText.zh: 完成后的展示更容易看懂，因为主要信息没有被装饰淹没。
